description: Create a MagicBlock PrivatePAY checkout or request the payment-required challenge for an existing checkout. Use this to begin a private checkout instead of create_paid_job with direct USDC; it returns commercial terms only and never signs, broadcasts, or moves funds.

inputSchema.description: Create a MagicBlock PrivatePAY checkout or request its x402 payment-required challenge. This is a quote and preparation step: it never signs, broadcasts, or moves funds.

amount_base_units.description: Quoted USDC amount in base units.

description.description: Human-readable commercial description shown in the checkout response.

expires_in_seconds.description: Challenge lifetime in seconds, between one minute and one day.

payer.description: Solana payer wallet public key; never a private key.

payment_id.description: Existing 64-character checkout identifier when phase is challenge.

phase.description: Use create for a new checkout or challenge to request the payment-required response for an existing payment_id.

resource.description: HTTPS resource or service endpoint being purchased.

name: privatepay_checkout

outputSchema.description: Private checkout terms, request identifiers, and payment requirements.

title: PrivateDAO Private Checkout
